# FlyerTalk

> > The world's most popular frequent flyer community covering airline loyalty programs, hotel rewards, elite status, and aviation industry news.

FlyerTalk provides comprehensive coverage of frequent flyer programs including Delta SkyMiles, American AAdvantage, Southwest Rapid Rewards, and hotel loyalty programs like Hilton Honors and Wyndham Rewards. The site tracks airline industry developments, mergers, bankruptcies, premium cabin launches, and loyalty program changes affecting travelers worldwide.

## Key Topics

- Loyalty programs and points redemption
- Elite status benefits and status matches
- Ultra-low-cost carriers (Spirit, Frontier)
- Airline mergers and bankruptcy restructuring
- Premium cabins and first class products
- Hotel rewards programs (Hilton, Wyndham, Choice)
- Airline alliances (SkyTeam)
- Digital innovations (AirTags, digital bag tags)
- Lounge access policies
- Airline partnerships and co-branding
- Aviation safety and accidents
- Frequent flyer credit cards
- Wi-Fi and onboard amenities

## Airline Industry Developments

- [Spirit Breaks Out of Bankruptcy Without Merger](https://www.flyertalk.com/articles/spirit-breaks-out-of-bankruptcy-without-merger.html): Spirit Airlines exits Chapter 11 bankruptcy as independent carrier
- [Delta Flight in Toronto Lands Upside Down, Injuring 18 Flyers](https://www.flyertalk.com/articles/delta-flight-in-toronto-lands-upside-down-injuring-18-flyers.html): Endeavor Air CRJ-900 crashes upside down at Toronto Pearson, 18 injured
- [Preliminary Investigation Blames Russian Missile for Azerbaijan Airlines Crash](https://www.flyertalk.com/articles/preliminary-investigation-blames-russian-missile-for-azerbaijan-airlines-crash.html): Azerbaijan Airlines Flight 8243 crash linked to Russian antiaircraft missile
- [Frontier Airlines Goes First Class in 2025](https://www.flyertalk.com/articles/frontier-airlines-goes-first-class-in-2025.html): ULCC Frontier Airlines adds first class seating starting late 2025
- [Spirit, Frontier Remain at Odds Over Potential Merger](https://www.flyertalk.com/articles/spirit-frontier-remain-at-odds-over-potential-merger.html): Spirit & Frontier merger negotiations stall over concession disagreements
- [Can a Airbus A380 Airline Redefine Trans-Atlantic Travel?](https://www.flyertalk.com/articles/can-a-airbus-a380-airline-redefine-trans-atlantic-travel.html): Global Airlines startup plans transatlantic A380 service from JFK to UK
- [Making Air Travel Great Again? The Public Would Like a Word…](https://www.flyertalk.com/articles/making-air-travel-great-again-the-public-would-like-a-word.html): Transportation Secretary Sean Duffy receives public feedback on air travel

## Airline Loyalty Programs & Elite Status

- [American Becomes Next Carrier to Offer Free Wi-Fi to Loyalty Members](https://www.flyertalk.com/articles/american-becomes-next-carrier-to-offer-free-wi-fi-to-loyalty-members.html): American Airlines offers free Wi-Fi to AAdvantage members starting Jan 2026
- [Delta Partners with Uber to Earn SkyMiles](https://www.flyertalk.com/articles/delta-partners-with-uber-to-earn-skymiles.html): Delta partners with Uber & Uber Eats to earn SkyMiles on rides and orders
- [SkyTeam Changes Lounge Access Rules](https://www.flyertalk.com/articles/skyteam-changes-lounge-access-rules.html): SkyTeam expands lounge access for elite members including domestic flights
- [Frontier Takes Another Swing at Southwest With Status Match](https://www.flyertalk.com/articles/frontier-takes-another-swing-at-southwest-with-status-match.html): Frontier offers Elite Gold status match to Southwest Rapid Rewards members
- [Spirit Brings Two Free Checked Bags to Credit Card Holders](https://www.flyertalk.com/articles/spirit-brings-two-free-checked-bags-to-credit-card-holders.html): Spirit adds 2 free checked bags for Free Spirit credit card holders

## Premium Cabins & Aircraft Enhancements

- [Air France Announces New La Première First Class](https://www.flyertalk.com/articles/air-france-announces-new-la-premiere-first-class.html): Air France unveils new La Première first class suites on Boeing 777-300ER
- [United Unveils United Polaris Studio Aboard New Dreamliners](https://www.flyertalk.com/articles/united-unveils-united-polaris-studio-aboard-new-dreamliners.html): United launches Polaris Studio premium suites on 787-9 Dreamliners in 2026
- [JetBlue Adjusts Premium Economy with EvenMore](https://www.flyertalk.com/articles/jetblue-adjusts-premium-economy-with-evenmore.html): JetBlue launches EvenMore premium economy with overhead bins & free drinks

## Travel Technology & Innovation

- [Airlines and Apple Work Together Using AirTags to Find Lost Luggage](https://www.flyertalk.com/articles/airlines-and-apple-work-together-using-airtags-to-find-lost-luggage.html): Apple iOS 18.2 enables 15+ airlines to track lost luggage via AirTags
- [Alaska Launches Digital Bag Tag for Sale](https://www.flyertalk.com/articles/alaska-launches-digital-bag-tag-for-sale.html): Alaska Airlines launches NFC digital bag tags after 18-month trial

- [Choice Privileges Extends Award Window, Brings Back AwardSaver](https://www.flyertalk.com/articles/choice-privileges-extends-award-window-brings-back-awardsaver.html): Choice Privileges extends booking window, revives AwardSaver from Radisson
